about.title: IGN Explorer
about.intro: Browse the open data catalogue of the IGN Géoplateforme in 3D: add aerial imagery, maps, elevation models and vector layers, and combine them on the globe.
about.demonstrator_title: A demonstrator of the Horizon engine
about.demonstrator_text: This application is a demonstrator of {horizon}, Siradel's open source geospatial 3D engine, which grew out of the {sce} ecosystem.
about.experiment_text: Layers are displayed as published by their producers, without any validation, and the 3D rendering may contain small errors.
about.affiliation: IGN Explorer is not an official IGN product: it is neither affiliated with nor endorsed by the Institut national de l'information géographique et forestière, and only uses the public services of the Géoplateforme.
about.privacy_text: No account, no cookies, no analytics. Map data and address searches are requested directly by your browser from the IGN Géoplateforme and, for the OpenMapTiles layer, from data.gouv.fr.
about.sources_text: Layers come from the IGN Géoplateforme (mostly Licence Ouverte 2.0) and, for OpenMapTiles, from OpenStreetMap data served by the DINUM on data.gouv.fr, which is not an IGN service. The Attributions panel credits the layers on screen.
